note: Ableton renders from ToAddTry3/Cold and ToAddTry3/Meta (44.1 kHz, 16-bit, MIDI at 96 PPQ with no tempo), found by tools/content/catalogue.py (docs/MUSIC_CATALOGUE.md). Run: python tools/content/import_ableton.py content/imports/cold_meta.json, then python tools/content/build.py. Clip lengths follow the recordings: a 4-bar pattern is a 4-bar clip (the library tiles it over its 8-bar loop), an 8-bar pattern an 8-bar clip, a 16-bar percussion loop a 16-bar backing. Where a render is longer than its pattern (the Cold and Meta kick, snare and Meta bass renders are 16 bars of an 8-bar, 4-bar or 1-bar MIDI pattern repeated; Bass2Trap is 16 bars of a 4-bar pattern) the clip keeps the first bars and the cut is recorded in clip.json (frames_in, dropped_frames, bars_in); the dropped bars repeat the MIDI that is kept, they are not other material. Timbre renders of one MIDI are sounds of one clip: Bass2 to Bass5 and Meta Bass1 each declare bass_hard_harmonic, bass_flaring_anger and bass_trap. Keys are the catalogue's estimates (advisory, confidence in each note); the percussion backings are atonal and go with every bass line. Levels as first_watch.json: drums and bass peak at -4 dBFS, bass RMS-matched to -17 dBFS where that peak allows (so the three timbres of a pattern sound equally loud), backing at -3 dBFS, then a global trim of -7 dB.

clips.name: Cold Groove
clips.note: Cold Kick2 with Snare2. The renders are 16 bars of an 8-bar kick pattern and a 1-bar snare pattern repeated; the first 8 bars are the clip (the MIDI of bars 9 to 16 is a copy of bars 1 to 8). Same notes as Meta Kick1 and Snare1.

clips.name: Meta Groove A
clips.note: Meta Kick1 with Snare1: the 16-bar renders repeat an 8-bar kick pattern; the first 8 bars are the clip.

clips.name: Meta Groove B
clips.note: Meta Kick2 with Snare1: the busier kick pattern (52 notes in 16 bars); the first 8 bars are the clip.

clips.name: Cold Bass 2
clips.note: Bass2: a 4-bar pattern (long notes with a pickup) that the MIDI repeats four times; the Trap render is 16 bars, the other two 4, so every render is cut to the first 4 bars. Key B minor, estimate confidence 0.37.

clips.name: Cold Bass 3
clips.note: Bass3: eight notes over 4 bars. Key A# minor, estimate confidence 0.20 (the key is a guess).

clips.name: Cold Bass 4
clips.note: Bass4: eleven notes over 4 bars with short pickups. Key F major, estimate confidence 0.56.

clips.name: Cold Bass 5
clips.note: Bass5: ten notes over 4 bars; the renders keep sounding for 1.8 bars after the MIDI ends, so one bar of the release is kept and the rest is cut (warned). Key E minor, estimate confidence 0.51.

clips.name: Meta Bass 1
clips.note: Meta Bass1: a 24-note line whose 8-bar pattern the 16-bar renders repeat once; the first 8 bars are the clip. Key F major, estimate confidence 0.82.
